values.note: Non-electric $20, electric $33, Sweet Gum electric with water $35, full hookup $40 per night; plus the Indiana entrance fee.

fees.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570053 (every site's price for 6/15/2027; non-electric sites allow 33 ft and up, so the $20 base fits a 23-ft motorhome), read 2026-11-02

hookups.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570053 (per-site Electricity Hookup 30 or 50, 35 sites at 50 amp; 12 Full Hookup sites list water and sewer Y), read 2026-11-02

values.note: 181 on the booking site: 127 electric (including Maple Loop 301-310 and Sweet Gum 401-411), 12 full hookup and 42 non-electric. Every one allows at least 33 ft. The DNR page's counts add up to 174 (8 full hookup, 114 electric, 42 non-electric, 10 Maple Loop).

sites.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IN&parkId=570053 (site list and Max Vehicle Length per site) + https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/parks-lakes/shakamak-state-park/, read 2026-11-02 (18 sites list Pull-Through)

note: Indiana state park near Jasonville with three man-made fishing lakes (electric trolling motors only), swimming pool, rental boats and trails. About two-thirds of the campsites are wooded. --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed ($20 base fits, $40 high; added Sweet Gum $35). Count 170 -> 181 on the booking site; electric -> 50, water and sewer true, store added. Not waterfront stands; alerts 0.
flags: PHONE missing: the park office is 812-665-2158 (DNR park page and campground map). apply.py writes no phone.

WATERFRONT stays not waterfront, on what I read: ReserveAmerica's 'Lakefront' tag sits only on cabins (1, 9-21, 24-26, Lakeview A and B), on no RV site. Plotted GIS: electric sites 36-40 lie on the lake side of the west loop road, ~35-40 m from the shore through continuous forest. Official site photos for 36, 37, 38, 39 and 40 (ReserveAmerica webphotos, leaf-on) show open woods and no water, so no *view is earned. A leaf-off visit could say otherwise; nothing official shows it.
